rules: Use IBM Plex Mono for technical numbers (distance, lat/lon).

grids.kpi_cards: High Density Grid. grid-cols-3 with gap-4.

layouts.overall_structure: Map-centric fixed full-screen layout. Left sidebar (w-[400px]) for controls, right area (flex-1) for Leaflet Map.
layouts.sidebar: Flex-col, h-screen. Sticky Header. Fixed KPI panel. Add/Search input section. Scrollable flex-1 list for stops. Fixed bottom CTA area for Optimize Route.

components.stop_list_item: bg-slate-800 border border-slate-700 hover:border-slate-500 rounded p-3 mb-2 flex items-center gap-3. Draggable. Left drag handle, square number badge, details flex-1, right delete button.
components.buttons: Tactical styling. Primary: Solid #FF6B00, black text, font-bold, slightly aggressive sharp edges (rounded-sm), shadow-[2px_2px_0px_rgba(255,107,0,0.5)].
components.map_markers: Custom Leaflet divIcons. CSS styled HTML markers instead of image pins. Numbered 1-N. Depot marker has distinct square shape and success color.

visual_enhancers.map_theme: Apply CSS filter `filter: invert(100%) hue-rotate(180deg) brightness(95%) contrast(90%);` to Leaflet tile layer to achieve dark mode over default OSM tiles.
visual_enhancers.toast: Use sonner for notifications (e.g. Stop added, Route Optimized, Export successful).

motion.interactions: framer-motion for list reordering. hover states with fast transitions.
motion.map: FlyToBounds animation when route is calculated to focus on the active polyline.

accessibility.contrast: Black text on Primary (#FF6B00) button. All text meets APCA.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.

avatar.description: User profile avatar for the dashboard header

instructions_to_main_agent: TECH STACK: React (.js), Tailwind CSS, Leaflet/react-leaflet.
CRITICAL: Do NOT create .tsx files. Use standard .js or .jsx files.
GEOCODING: Use OpenStreetMap Nominatim for the search input. Fetch from `https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search?q={query}&format=json&limit=5`.

MAP ROUTING & POLYLINE: Use OSRM public API `https://router.project-osrm.org/route/v1/driving/{coords}?overview=full&geometries=geojson` to get a real road polyline. Format coords as `lon,lat;lon,lat`. Render as <GeoJSON> or <Polyline> in react-leaflet.
OPTIMIZATION LOGIC: Implement a 'Nearest Neighbor' heuristic in JS to sort the array of stops. Start at Depot (index 0), find nearest unvisited stop, repeat, then return to Depot.
EXCEL PARSING: Use `xlsx` library to parse incoming Excel/CSV with columns like Address, Lat, Lng.
STATE: Maintain global stops array. First item = Depot. When order changes, update the route polyline.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
DO NOT apply universal transition (transition: all). Add specific transitions.
DO NOT center align the app container. Keep text left-aligned.
NEVER use emojis as icons. Use lucide-react icons.
DO NOT use complete transparent background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
